blind.description: A rectangular section of masonry wall constructed from dark grey and charcoal bricks with occasional brownish tones. A capstone trim runs across the top edge. A prominent horizontal red stripe (resembling paint or blood) wraps around the upper-middle section, with drips running downward along the mortar lines. The geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with sharp edges and no floating or melted parts. The bottom sits directly flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: A thin, elongated dark grey rectangle with slightly beveled corners representing the wall's top coping stone.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 ft tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 ft wide, with a thin thickness of under 1 ft.
